modified_caption: The bar chart illustrates the average performance across five training methods on 11 datasets. The horizontal axis lists the methods: 'Standard,' 'Self-RAG,' 'FactTune,' 'ClInGS (w/),' and 'ClInGS,' in ascending order of performance. The vertical axis represents 'Average Performance,' ranging from 0 to 60, with intervals of 10 units. The 'ClInGS' method consistently outperformed all others, achieving an average performance of approximately 62, while 'FactTune' showed the lowest performance at around 48. The 'Self-RAG' method demonstrated a slight decline compared to 'Standard,' which maintained stable performance across datasets. The chart highlights the superiority of the 'ClInGS' methods, particularly the standalone 'ClInGS' approach, which exhibited a significant improvement over its variant 'ClInGS (w/).'
